stories.title: DOJ looks to dismiss Alaska Senate lawsuit
stories.summary: The Department of Justice (DOJ) is looking to dismiss its lawsuit that was focused on blocking the certification of Alaska’s Senate race if Sen.-elect Mary Peltola (D) won, according to Thursday court filings.
